message: include chain is V_depth levels deep, exceeding the limit of V_limit
why: The limit exists so a hostile or accidental chain cannot exhaust the stack. It is far above any readable design — if you hit it, the header layout is the problem, not the limit.
fix: flatten the hierarchy: put shared declarations in one leaf header
or split the deepest header into two that are siblings rather than nested
